newsitem.title: THAILAND: Finance One says unhurt by One Holding.
newsitem.headline: Finance One says unhurt by One Holding.

text.p: Finance One Plc said on Tuesday it was not affected by the inability of One Holding Plc, in which it has about a 10 percent stake, to meet repayment on bills of exchange.

"One Holding is a debtor of Finance One with a balance of about 1.0 billion baht for loans and bills of exchange. However, Finance One holds sufficient collateral to cover the entire amount," the finance company said in a statement to the Thai stock exchange.
Thailand's largest finance firm, Finance One, added that the book value of its 9.91 percent stake in One Holding's paid up capital amounted to about 340 million baht ($13 million).

The stock exchange on Wednesday suspended One Holding following the firm's announcement that it could not honour repayment on two maturing bills of exchange worth a combined $13.5 million on Monday and Tuesday.

One Holding said in a statement its financial advisors were negotiating with creditors on restructuring the debt. Finance One, said by analysts to be hit by liquidity problems, last Friday signed an agreement to merge with medium-sized Thai Danu Bank to form a new combined entity under the name Thai Danu Bank.
